instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Precision Components Inc. is a medium-sized manufacturer specializing in high-tolerance metal components for the automotive and industrial machinery sectors. We operate primarily within North America, focusing on established supply chains and maintaining high quality standards.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have recently invested in upgrading our CNC machinery to reduce production time by 15%. Previously, R&D efforts were limited mainly to incremental material science improvements rather than market expansion projects.
answers.strategicGoals: The company's primary goal is strategic diversification into adjacent industrial sectors while maintaining profitability in our core components business. We aim to establish a secondary product line within the next three years.
answers.teamSize: The R&D and strategy team is small, consisting of five key personnel dedicated to process optimization and market analysis.
answers.additionalContext: Competition is fierce in the component sector, requiring us to continually innovate on cost efficiency and niche specialization.

opportunities.title: Automation of Low-Tolerance Processes
opportunities.rationale: Implementing targeted automation in specific component finishing stages will reduce operational costs and improve quality consistency without requiring massive capital expenditure or major structural change.

first_actions: Identify the three highest-volume, lowest-margin processes for automation review.
Pilot a robotic handling system on one non-critical component line.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in direct labor costs by 12% within 6 months.
milestones: Q3: Pilot system operational and ROI calculated.

opportunities.title: Niche Market Penetration (Specialty Alloys)
opportunities.rationale: Diversification can be achieved by focusing on a highly specialized material niche where our precision capabilities offer a competitive edge, minimizing the risk associated with entering entirely new markets.

first_actions: Conduct market analysis for three high-growth specialty alloys.
Develop targeted marketing materials for potential partners.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure two new contracts in the specialized alloy market by year-end.

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnership/Acquisition in Adjacent Tech
opportunities.rationale: To achieve true diversification, a conservative approach to M&A or strategic alliances can provide immediate access to new technologies (like advanced AI-driven design) that fundamentally change our production capabilities.

first_actions: Establish an internal M&A screening criteria matrix for synergistic tech.
Identify three potential small, agile software startups specializing in design optimization.
execution_plan.success_metric: Finalize a binding strategic partnership agreement within 12 months.

next_steps.action: Conduct a full audit of current operational bottlenecks and prioritize the top three candidates for automation.
Begin formal market research on specialty alloys to validate diversification potential and build an initial business case.
Develop a detailed, phased implementation plan for the selected incremental automation project.

key_weaknesses: Limited internal expertise in digital transformation
High employee turnover within the R&D team
Lack of formal strategy linking current operations to long-term diversification goals
